summary: Tested Daily.co Video Calls integration for Thrifty Curator. Backend: 14/15 tests passed (93%). Frontend: Video Calls page loads correctly with tabs, admin header button works, IncomingCallBanner displays. One backend test failed due to Daily.co API returning 400 when cloud recording is enabled (likely account limitation). Fixed a React cleanup issue in VideoCallPage that caused 'Duplicate DailyIframe instances' error.

minor.issue: Daily.co API returns 400 Bad Request when cloud recording is enabled. This is likely a Daily.co account limitation, not a code bug.

integration_issues.issue: Missing cleanup function caused 'Duplicate DailyIframe instances' error in React strict mode. FIXED by adding callFrameRef cleanup in useEffect return.

action_items: Consider checking Daily.co account settings if cloud recording is needed - the API returns 400 when enable_recording='cloud' is set
The VideoCallPage cleanup fix has been applied - verify it works in production

context_for_next_testing_agent: Daily.co Video Calls feature tested. Key endpoints: POST /api/video-calls/rooms (create room), GET /api/video-calls/rooms/{room_name} (get room info), POST /api/video-calls/rooms/{room_name}/end (end call), GET /api/video-calls/history (call history), GET /api/video-calls/recordings (recordings list), POST /api/video-calls/call-request (worker requests call with admin), GET /api/video-calls/call-requests/pending (admin gets pending requests), POST /api/video-calls/call-requests/{id}/accept (accept request), POST /api/video-calls/call-requests/{id}/decline (decline request). Frontend data-testid attributes: video-calls-header-btn (admin header), video-calls-page, video-calls-tabs, active-calls-tab, history-tab, recordings-tab, start-call-btn, video-call-page, call-video-container, call-controls, toggle-audio-btn, toggle-video-btn, toggle-screenshare-btn, leave-call-btn. Note: Cloud recording may not work due to Daily.co account limitations.
